hook: The Riemann Hypothesis proof checks out in Lean.

beats.say: On November 20, Levent Alpöge released a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis as a Lean library with 17 million lines of code, depending only on Mathlib.
Within a day, dozens of people compiled it and reproduced the same raw proof export, and two independent tools confirmed it proves exactly Mathlib's statement.
Several proof checkers, including formally verified ones, accepted it, and the Lean and Mathlib communities now certify the proof as correct.
